text_block_list.text:
Rulership didn't show up for training. 
She's been slacking off a lot lately, so I 
go to pick her up and give her a stern 
talking-to.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Trainer!? What's with the scary 
face... I-It's not like I was planning to 
play games or anything...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I know! This is "preserving physical 
resources"... a tactic looking towards the 
long game!
